title: Unity Credit Bank cash register key

infobox.usage: Unlocks the customer desk booth no. 2 in the Tarbank on Ground Zero.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Unity Credit Bank cash register key (UC reg.) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the cash register inside the city center Unity Credit bank branch.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the customer desk booth no. 2 in the Tarbank on at Ground Zero.
